sophia (arch): Quick check-in: we need a compact runtime <-> policy contract for smart routing that balances latency, rollout safety, and observability.

mike (infra): Agreed. Two paths: heavier remote policy (expressive but adds RPC), or precompiled bundles (fast but rollout-heavy).

anna (pm): Product needs a stable surface to display and debug decisions. Can we agree a minimal response shape?

sophia (arch): Suggest RouteDecision: route_id, variant, reason_code (short enum), score (float), debug_token? for full explain. Keep fields tiny.

neal (ops): Telemetry must include policy_version, decision_path (bundle|service|fallback), decision_latency_ms, route_id, tenant_id, region, cache_hit. Sample full explains at 0.1%.

katie (eng): Runtime should support signed policy.bundle.v1 with bundle_version, ttl, required_runtime_version. Validate signature, reject stale. Local eval target p99 < 2ms. Remote only for miss/advanced eval.

mike (infra): Bundle format idea: precompiled matcher table + tiny VM. Runtime fallback: last-known-good bundle or simple region-cost heuristic. Remote RPC SLO p99 < 15ms.

anna (pm): Rollout plan: bundle advertises min_runtime_version and feature_flags. Orchestrate bundle rollout before switching default policy. Console shows bundle hash, rollout percent, sample explains.

neal (ops): Alerts: fallback spike, cache-miss surge, remote-failure rate. Metrics: routing.decision.latency_ms, routing.decision.cache_hit, routing.decision.remote_failures, routing.decision.fallback_applied, routing.decision.explain_samples.

katie (eng): Security: sign bundles with rotating keys; RPC mTLS + tenant tokens; debug tokens short-lived and audited.

sophia (arch): Action items: 1) RFC: RouteDecision schema + reason_code enum + debug-token flow. 2) Telemetry spec: tagset + sampling rates. 3) Prototype: policy.bundle.v1 + verifier + perf tests. 4) Console mock: rollout + sampled explain viewer. I'll open RFC and tag owners. Any objections?

deploy-bot: deploy status: no deploys in last 24h.

sophia (arch): If none, I'll start the writeup tomorrow. :thumbsup:
